jobs.title: Sales Manager, Indonesia
jobs.description: We are at the heart of every place that matters: as a leading global provider in the access solutions market, we enable people to move seamlessly in safe, secure and sustainable places. Do you want your work to matter? Then join our team! At dormakaba, more than 16,000 people from all over the world work together and grow together. If you are looking for exciting career prospects, if you want to fuel innovation and like tackling new challenges, then we would love to hear from you! Job Summary Sales Manager, Indonesia is responsible for AHS, AAS and ACS overall business development in Indonesia. He/She is responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth and market share within a defined territory. This role combines strategic account management, new-business development, and leadership of the local sales effort (mentoring junior reps if applicable). The ideal candidate is a high-ego, high-empathy sales professional who can navigate complex buyers, build executive-level relationships, and responsibly manage a multi-quarter pipeline. Key Responsibilities: Business Development & Plan Hold full P&L responsibility for total AHS, AAS, ACS with yearly target sales operations through direct training, leadership, and supervision the Channel & Project Distributor Sales Team. Deliver the annual sales plan and monitoring plan verses actual on a quarterly basis Develop and execute a comprehensive territory business plan aligned with company targets, including revenue goals, account coverage, channel strategy (if applicable), and market expansion initiatives. (e.g. AHS, AAS, ACS Distributor) Continue to work with specifier, project consultant and project distributors for the Project First Win Battle pipeline and win. Prospect, qualify, and close new business within the territory; own the full sales cycle from lead generation to contract negotiation and renewal. Manage and grow strategic accounts and/or channel partner relationships; conduct quarterly business reviews with top customers/partners. Liaise with the related departments (Supply chain, Sales, Product, Finance, Marketing, CS,..) on all technical and commercial issues pertaining to the project and track project deliverables. Product Category Supervision Define the products strategy and new product roadmap. Plan and organize to improve & develop the current product range. Supervise and provide the healthy supports to the team to ensure the workflow of subordinates is properly done. Implement and maintain the system to achieve objectives/KPI of individual, subordinates as well as the department. Manages new product introduction (NPI) and beta programs as required. Project & Project Development Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline with an accurate forecasting; use data-driven insights to adjust territory strategy and resource allocation. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Operations to ensure successful onboarding, deployment, and value realization for customers. Negotiate terms, pricing, and contracts; ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements. Monitor competitive landscape and market feedback; provide input to product and pricing strategies. Mentor, train, and coach junior Territory Managers or sales reps within the territory; share best practices and standardize sales processes. Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual quota; manage territory expense budget and travel within policy. Prepare timely reports and dashboards on territory performance, risks, and opportunities. Develop a project partner strategy and policy, competency mapping including compliance (S&L) and execute Distributor Performance Metrics and specific incentive programs. Continue training on dormakaba academy with technical and commercial training to Reseller, PPS, Studio Partner Continue with the investment on projects like Trade Marketing, POSM & Project Mockup Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred. Minimum 5– 8 years of sales experience in a relevant domain; 2+ years in a senior or leadership-capable role (mentoring, leading a small team, or owning a territory). Proven track record of meeting/exceeding quotas and closing complex or high-value deals. Strong account management skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, including C-level executives. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills. Proficiency with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and standard office tools; ability to analyze data and build business cases. Strategic thinker with strong planning, organizational, and time-management abilities. Customer-centric mindset with a results-driven, self-motivated work style. Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (e.g., 80%, depending on geography). WHAT YOU CAN TRUST IN: A FULFILLING WORKPLACE Supportive and collaborative team environment. Learning culture where every employee is engaged in learning and development growth. Team programs and activities that celebrate individual and team’s success. Long service award recognition to honor committed and dedicated colleagues. Ready to Join Us? If you're passionate about growth, success, and making a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of our dynamic, supportive team. Access your career at dormakaba today! We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is part of our overall business and sustainability strategy. We consider all applicants equally throughout the whole recruitment process without regard to culture, age, ethnicity, gender identity, disability, marital status, language, national origin, physical/ mental ability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, underrepresented communities, etc. We do not use unfair selection methods for any of our positions, all employees are appointed based on performance and suitability for the role * External Job Title

jobs.title: English Teacher
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced and enthusiastic English Teacher to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background and passion for teaching English and a great commitment to helping students achieve their language learning goals. Requirements : Bachelor's degree or higher in English, Education, or a relevant field. Knowledge of International Curricula will be most preferred. Able to commit to a minimum of a one-year contract. Minimum of 3 (three) years of teaching experience, preferably in an international or multicultural setting. Creative approach to teaching and learning. Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in classroom management. Immediate Hiring Process - Successful Candidate will start in January 2027. Responsibilities : Plan, prepare, and deliver high-quality English lessons to students. Developing teaching and learning program. Supervise, instruct and assist student’s process of learning, provide thorough feedback to students on their assignments, prepare and implement assessment items. Determine curriculum changes in general and for individual students. Prepare evidence of student outcomes through displays, portfolios, performances, and publications (newsletter, booklets, magazines). Support, motivate and encourage students in all aspects of school activities. Maintain accurate and complete records for students and all administration in an efficient, orderly and up-to-date manner. Maintain professional and open lines of communication with parents. Participate in professional development and school events.

Sebagai Admin Produksi, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mendukung operasi produksi perusahaan dengan tugas-tugas administratif yang efisien dan terorganisir. jobs.title: Staff Toko
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami di Toko 88 Makassar mencari Staff Toko yang berdedikasi dan profesional untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Sebagai Staff Toko, Anda akan menjadi tulang punggung operasional toko kami, berinteraksi langsung dengan pelanggan dan memastikan pengalaman berbelanja yang luar biasa. Posisi ini memerlukan seseorang yang energik, ramah, dan berorientasi pada layanan pelanggan dengan kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan ritel yang dinamis. Ini adalah posisi waktu penuh yang berlokasi di Makassar, Sulawesi Selatan , tempat Anda akan berkontribusi pada kesuksesan harian toko kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melayani pelanggan dengan ramah dan profesional, menjawab pertanyaan produk, dan membantu mereka menemukan barang Memastikan area toko tetap rapi, bersih, dan terorganisir dengan baik setiap saat. Melakukan restocking produk, mengatur display barang, dan memastikan semua item tersedia dan mudah ditemukan oleh pelanggan. Membantu dalam inventaris toko, melacak stok barang, dan melaporkan kepada atasan tentang ketersediaan produk. Mematuhi standar keselamatan dan kebersihan yang berlaku di toko. Bekerja sama dengan rekan kerja untuk mencapai target penjualan dan kepuasan pelanggan. Menangani keluhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan mencari solusi yang memuaskan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat. Pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun di bidang ritel atau toko, atau bersedia untuk belajar. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat. Sikap positif, ramah, dan siap melayani dengan sepenuh hati. Kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam tim dan mengikuti instruksi dengan baik. Perhatian terhadap detail dan tanggung jawab dalam menangani uang dan transaksi. Kedisiplinan waktu dan kehadiran yang konsisten. Kesediaan untuk bekerja dalam jadwal yang fleksibel termasuk hari libur national dan bisa pulang malam Pengalaman menggunakan sistem kasir atau POS dianggap sebagai nilai tambah. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif Bpjs kesehatan Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda tertarik untuk menjadi bagian dari tim Toko 88 Makassar dan memiliki semangat untuk memberikan layanan terbaik, kami sangat ingin mendengar dari Anda. Harap hubungi kami atau kirimkan CV Anda melalui saluran yang telah disediakan. Lamar sekarang dan mulai perjalanan karier Anda bersama kami!

jobs.title: E-Commerce Specialist
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day operations of e-commerce platforms (e.g., marketplace and online store). Upload and maintain product listings, pricing, promotions, and product information accuracy. Plan and execute online campaigns, promotions, and marketplace activities to drive sales performance. Monitor sales performance, traffic, and conversion rates, and provide regular analysis and reports. Coordinate with internal teams (Marketing, Sales, Warehouse) to ensure stock availability and smooth order fulfillment. Optimize product visibility through campaign participation, keyword optimization, and promotional strategies. Handle customer inquiries, ratings, and reviews to maintain positive customer experience. Conduct competitor analysis and monitor market trends to identify opportunities for growth in the e-commerce channel. Requirements Minimum Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Business, Marketing, Management, E-Commerce, or a related field. Minimum 1–3 years of experience in E-Commerce, Marketplace Management, or Digital Sales. Familiar with major e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopee, Tokopedia, Lazada, TikTok Shop, etc.). Strong understanding of marketplace features such as campaigns, promotions, ads, and analytics. Good analytical skills and ability to interpret sales data and performance metrics. Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Strong communication and coordination skills. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and reporting. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have) Experience managing online campaigns such as Flash Sale, Campaign Day (e.g., 9.9, 10.10, etc.). Basic understanding of digital marketing or marketplace advertising (Ads). Experience in consumer goods, retail, or lifestyle products industry.

jobs.title: Sales Supervisor
jobs.description: Job Deskripsi : Memimpin, mengelola, dan memotivasi tim penjualan untuk mencapai dan melampaui target penjualan bulanan, kuartalan, dan tahunan. Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan strategi penjualan yang efektif untuk meningkatkan revenue dan memperluas basis pelanggan. Melakukan monitoring dan evaluasi kinerja tim secara berkala, memberikan feedback konstruktif, dan mengidentifikasi kebutuhan pelatihan. Mengelola hubungan dengan klien kunci, memastikan kepuasan pelanggan, dan mengidentifikasi peluang cross-selling dan upselling. Melakukan analisis pasar dan kompetisi untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan dan tren industri perabotan online. Menyusun laporan penjualan dan presentasi hasil kinerja kepada manajemen senior secara berkala. Mengkoordinasikan dengan departemen lain seperti marketing, operasional, dan customer service untuk memastikan efisiensi operasional. Mengembangkan proposal dan negosiasi kontrak dengan calon pelanggan korporat dan retail. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal S1 (Sarjana) dalam bidang Manajemen, Pemasaran, Bisnis, atau disiplin ilmu terkait. Minimal 5 tahun pengalaman dalam manajemen penjualan, dengan pengalaman di industri perabotan, furnitur, retail, atau sektor consumer goods menjadi nilai tambah. Pengalaman terbukti dalam mencapai dan melampaui target penjualan dengan track record yang solid. Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan pengalaman mengelola tim penjualan minimal 5 orang atau lebih. Keterampilan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis. Kemampuan analitis yang kuat untuk menginterpretasi data penjualan dan membuat keputusan berbasis data. Pemahaman mendalam tentang siklus penjualan dan proses B2B serta B2C. Kecakapan dalam menggunakan software CRM dan tools penjualan digital. Kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan cepat berubah dengan fokus pada pencapaian hasil. Pengetahuan tentang platform e-commerce dan penjualan online dianggap sebagai keunggulan kompetitif.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Sinar Eterna', perusahaan konstruksi di Jakarta, saat ini mencari Project Manager yang handal untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Sebagai Project Manager, Anda akan memainkan peran kunci dalam mengawasi dan mengelola berbagai proyek konstruksi INDUSTRI perusahaan, memastikan penyelesaian tepat waktu dan sesuai anggaran. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengembangkan dan mengelola rencana proyek yang komprehensif, mencakup anggaran, jadwal, dan tujuan yang jelas. Mengkoordinasikan dan mengawasi tim proyek, termasuk kontraktor, subkontraktor, dan pemasok, untuk memastikan pelaksanaan pekerjaan sesuai spesifikasi dan standar kualitas. Memantau kemajuan proyek secara teratur, mengidentifikasi dan mengatasi masalah atau risiko yang muncul. Menjaga komunikasi yang efektif dengan pemangku kepentingan, termasuk klien, manajemen perusahaan, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan dan standar keselamatan yang berlaku. Mengevaluasi kinerja proyek setelah penyelesaian dan mengidentifikasi area perbaikan untuk proyek mendatang. Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan Memiliki gelar Sarjana dalam bidang Teknik Sipil, Manajemen Konstruksi, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5 tahun sebagai Project Manager di industri konstruksi. Pemahaman yang mendalam tentang manajemen proyek, termasuk perencanaan, penjadwalan, anggaran, dan pengendalian risiko. Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, dengan keterampilan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang baik. Mahir dalam menggunakan perangkat lunak manajemen proyek, seperti Microsoft Project atau Primavera. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik tentang peraturan dan standar keselamatan di industri konstruksi. Manfaat yang Ditawarkan Paket kompensasi yang kompetitif, termasuk gaji yang menarik dan bonus kinerja. Asuransi kesehatan, program pensiun, dan tunjangan lainnya yang komprehensif. Kesempatan untuk mengembangkan karier dalam perusahaan terkemuka di industri konstruksi. Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan kolaboratif, dengan dukungan tim yang solid. Pelatihan dan pengembangan profesional yang berkelanjutan. Tentang PT Sinar Eterna' PT Sinar Eterna' adalah perusahaan konstruksi terkemuka di Indonesia yang berpengalaman lebih dari 20 tahun. Kami telah menyelesaikan berbagai proyek INDUSTRI, komersial, dan residensial terkemuka di Jakarta dan sekitarnya. Berkomitmen pada inovasi, keunggulan, dan budaya keselamatan, PT Sinar Eterna' terus memperluas eksistensinya di pasar konstruksi Indonesia. Jika Anda tertarik dan memenuhi persyaratan yang dibutuhkan, lamar sekarang dan bergabunglah dengan tim kami yang dinamis di PT Sinar Eterna'!

jobs.title: GENERAL AFFAIR
jobs.description: PT Daya Pratama Lestari merupakan perusahaan textil yang terletak di Batujajar, Kab Bandung Barat. Saat ini kami sedang mencari General Affair untuk membantu efektifitas operasional perusahaan. Tugas dan Tanggungjawab : Bertanggungjawab terhadap gedung, fasilitas kantor, kebersihan, keamanan, serta kendaraan (termasuk perpanjangan STNK dan KIR). Bertanggungjawab terhadap Outsourcing seperti Security, Driver, dan Cleaner. Melaksanakan pekerjaan administratif GA Menyusun dan melakukan pengawasan/kontrol terhadap aturan serta tata tertib karyawan. Menjaga hubungan baik dengan pihak eksternal (warga, kedinasan, satgas, ormas, dsb) Menjaga serta merawat aset perusahaan mulai dari gedung, kendaraan, dan aset/fasilitas lainnya. Bersedia mengendarai motor/mobil untuk dinas luar. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal S1 semua jurusan. Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai GA pabrik. Loyal, tegas, jujur, dan disiplin. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, koordinasi, serta negosiasi yang baik. Mampu memimpin tim, bekerja secara individu maupun tim. Terbiasa berhubungan dengan Dinas, Instansi, LSM, maupun warga. Mobilitas tinggi serta mempunyai SIM A & SIM C yang valid.

jobs.title: Finance, Accounting & Tax Supervisor
jobs.description: 🔍 Qualifications - Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. - Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Finance, Accounting & Tax, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory position. - Holds Brevet A & B certification. - Strong understanding of accounting principles (PSAK), financial reporting, taxation, and financial management. - Experienced in preparing and reviewing financial statements. - Proficient in Microsoft Excel. - Experienced in using accounting systems/ERP software. - Familiar with tax reporting (PPh 21, PPh 23, PPh 25, PPh 4(2), PPN) and Corporate Income Tax. - Familiar with preparing LKPM and other statutory reports. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. - Excellent leadership, communication, and team management abilities. - Able to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines. - High integrity, detail-oriented, and committed to accuracy. - Have experience in the F&B, hospitality, or retail industry is an advantage. - Experienced in inventory costing, COGS analysis, and restaurant financial reporting. - Experienced in handling multi-outlet financial operations is preferred. 📋 Responsibilities - Supervise, guide, and evaluate the performance of the Finance, Accounting & Tax team. - Ensure daily financial operations run effectively and in accordance with company policies. - Monitor and ensure healthy cash flow management. - Review and monitor Accounts Receivable (AR) & Accounts Payable (AP) aging, including collection and payment schedules. - Oversee bank reconciliations and ensure all bank account mutations are properly recorded and supported. - Prepare budgets, forecasts, and financial projections while monitoring budget realization. - Analyze financial performance and provide recommendations to improve operational efficiency and profitability. - Ensure financial statements, tax reports, excise reports, LKPM, and other regulatory reports are prepared accurately and submitted on time. - Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal company policies. - Review tax calculations, reconciliations, and tax compliance to minimize financial and tax risks. - Support management in strategic financial planning and business decision-making. - Continuously identify opportunities to improve finance and accounting processes and internal controls.

jobs.title: Creative designer
jobs.description: Wajib melampirkan portofolio desain dan video — mengutamakan kandidat dengan sampel desain yang membutuhkan skill tinggi dan memiliki sample design kemasan. KUALIFIKASI : Pendidikan minimal S1 Desain Grafis, Desain Komunikasi Visual (DKV), Multimedia atau bidang terkait. Menguasai Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) / canva / software/aplikasi foto/video lainnya. Memiliki kemampuan fotografi & videografi dan kemampuan editing foto & video dengan hasil yang menarik dan profesional. Memiliki kreativitas tinggi serta mampu menghasilkan konsep visual yang sesuai dengan identitas brand. Memahami branding, layout, tipografi, warna, dan visual storytelling. Nilai tambah jika kamu juga menguasai:AI creative tool. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas jika diperlukan untuk kebutuhan dokumentasi atau event perusahaan DESKRIPSI PEKERJAAN : Membuat desain visual untuk kebutuhan penjualan & promosi perusahaan. Membuat konten media sosial & E commerce yang menarik dan sesuai dengan identitas brand. Melakukan pengambilan foto & mengedit foto (product photography maupun event). Melakukan pengambilan video & mengedit video untuk konten promosi, aktivitas perusahaan. Menjaga konsistensi identitas visual (brand guideline) pada seluruh materi perusahaan. Mengelola dan mengupload produk & foto pada E-commerce & social media. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi, khususnya dalam pemanfaatan Artificial Intelligence (AI) untuk kebutuhan kreatif.

jobs.title: Poultry Slaughterhouse (RPA) Manager
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the overall business strategy for the RPA operation. Own and deliver the annual budget, business plan, and profitability targets of the RPA business. Monitor and improve margins through optimization of procurement, production yield, product mix, pricing, and operational efficiency. Analyze business performance and implement corrective actions to achieve sales, volume, and profitability targets. Develop and execute strategies to grow revenue and market share across key sales channels. Establish KPIs and performance management systems across all functions. Define commercial strategy across: Modern Trade, General Trade, Horeca, Food Processors, Distributors and wholesale Review sales performance, customer profitability, and market trends. Support key account development and strategic customer relationships. Ensure alignment between market demand and production capabilities. Drive profitable revenue growth and market share expansion. Ensure efficient and cost-effective slaughterhouse operations. Drive continuous improvement in productivity, yield, labor efficiency, and cost management. Optimize plant capacity utilization, production scheduling, and asset performance. Ensure compliance with food safety, Halal, animal welfare, NKV, HACCP, ISO, and regulatory requirements. Implement operational excellence programs to improve quality, safety, and efficiency. Manage sourcing and procurement activities for live birds, packaging materials, ingredients, and operational supplies. Develop procurement strategies that ensure competitive cost, quality, and continuity of supply. Manage supplier relationships and contract negotiations. Monitor market developments impacting raw material and live bird pricing. Implement procurement controls and cost-saving initiatives. Build and develop a high-performing management team. Drive succession planning and capability development. Foster collaboration among commercial, operational, and supply chain functions. Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. Qualications: Minimum 10 years of experience in poultry processing, food manufacturing, protein, FMCG, or related industries. Minimum 5 years in a senior business leadership role with P&L responsibility. Proven experience leading managers across commercial and operational functions. Strong exposure to Modern Trade, General Trade, Horeca, and Food Processor channels. Experience in poultry processing, fresh foods, chilled or frozen products is highly preferred. Strategic thinking and business development capability.

jobs.title: Staff Gudang (Stocker & Delivery)
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Melakukan penerimaan, pengecekan, dan penyimpanan barang sesuai prosedur. Menata, menyusun, dan merapikan barang di area gudang agar tertata dengan baik. Melakukan stocking barang sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Melakukan stock opname secara berkala serta memastikan kesesuaian antara stok fisik dan sistem. Menyiapkan, memeriksa, dan mengemas barang untuk pengiriman. Melakukan pengiriman barang kepada pelanggan atau cabang menggunakan kendaraan operasional perusahaan. Memastikan barang yang dikirim dalam kondisi baik dan sesuai dengan dokumen pengiriman. Membantu proses bongkar muat barang. Menjaga kebersihan, kerapihan, dan keamanan area gudang. Melaporkan apabila terdapat selisih stok, kerusakan, atau kendala operasional kepada atasan. Melaksanakan tugas lain yang berkaitan dengan operasional gudang sesuai arahan atasan. Kualifikasi P, usia 20–35 tahun. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Staff Gudang, Stocker, atau Delivery menjadi nilai tambah. Wajib memiliki SIM A dan SIM B yang masih berlaku. Mampu mengendarai mobil operasional (pickup, box, atau kendaraan niaga sejenis). Memahami proses stock opname dan pengelolaan stok barang. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan jujur. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Sehat jasmani dan rohani serta mampu mengangkat barang sesuai kebutuhan pekerjaan. Bersedia ditempatkan di Cikarang.

jobs.title: BRANCH MANAGER
jobs.description: PT Oasis Waters International, perusahaan terkemuka di Indonesia yang memproduksi produk air minum dalam kemasan, sedang mencari kandidat yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan team kami sebagai BRANCH MANAGER (AREA BANDUNG) Kami membuka kesempatan bagi profesional yang memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan, berorientasi pada hasil, dan siap menghadapi tantangan untuk bergabung diperusahaan kami. Kualifikasi : 1. Pendidikan minimal S1 semua jurusan. 2. Usia maksimal 35 tahun. 3. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Branch Manager, Area Manager, Sales Manager, atau posisi setara. 4. Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman di industri Air Minum Dalam Kemasan (AMDK), Logistik, atau Jasa Ekspedisi. 5. Wajib menguasai Microsoft Excel, terutama Pivot Table, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, serta rumus-rumus operasional lainnya. 6. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi, analisa, dan problem solving yang baik. 7. Berorientasi pada hasil, disiplin, tegas, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. 8. Berdomisili di Bandung atau putra daerah Bandung menjadi nilai tambah. Tanggung Jawab 1. Bertanggung jawab penuh atas pencapaian target penjualan yang ditetapkan oleh perusahaan. 2. Mengembangkan pasar baru serta mempertahankan dan meningkatkan penjualan pelanggan yang sudah ada. 3. Memastikan seluruh operasional cabang berjalan efektif, efisien, dan sesuai dengan standar perusahaan. 4. Memimpin, mengawasi, serta mengembangkan kinerja seluruh tim di cabang. 5. Mengelola penggunaan sumber daya (manpower, armada, dan operasional) secara optimal. 6. Menyusun laporan penjualan dan operasional secara berkala kepada manajemen. 7. Bertanggung jawab atas pencapaian target perusahaan, baik dari aspek penjualan maupun operasional cabang. Kriteria yang Kami Cari : 1. Memiliki mental pemimpin yang kuat dan mampu menjadi teladan bagi tim. 2. Mampu mengambil keputusan dengan cepat, tepat, dan bertanggung jawab. 3. Memiliki integritas, loyalitas, dan komitmen tinggi terhadap pencapaian target perusahaan. Penempatan: Bandung

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Head Chef to lead our culinary operations at Restoran Payakumbuah Samarinda. This is a full-time position based in Samarinda, East Kalimantan, where you will take charge of the kitchen and be responsible for creating exceptional dining experiences for our guests. As Head Chef, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining our restaurant's reputation for quality, consistency, and authentic cuisine whilst leading and inspiring your kitchen team to achieve excellence.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing all kitchen operations, including food preparation, cooking, and plating to ensure dishes meet our high standards of quality and presentation

  • Creating and refining menus that showcase authentic culinary traditions whilst maintaining seasonal relevance and cost-effectiveness

  • Managing kitchen inventory, including ordering supplies, controlling food costs, and minimising waste

  • Leading, training, and motivating kitchen staff, including sous chefs, cooks, and kitchen assistants, fostering a collaborative and professional environment

  • Maintaining strict food safety and hygiene standards in compliance with local health and safety regulations

  • Ensuring consistent execution of recipes and cooking techniques across all shifts and services

  • Collaborating with front-of-house management to respond to guest feedback and adapt offerings accordingly

  • Planning and executing special events, themed menus, and promotional dishes as required

  • Managing kitchen budget and labour costs whilst maintaining quality standards

  • Staying current with culinary trends and techniques to continuously enhance our menu offerings


What we're looking for

  • Minimum 5-7 years of professional culinary experience, with at least 2-3 years in a head chef or senior kitchen leadership role

  • Extensive knowledge of Indonesian and Southeast Asian cuisine, particularly regional specialities

  • Proven expertise in kitchen management, including staff supervision, scheduling, and cost control

  • Strong understanding of food safety regulations, hygiene standards, and best practices in food handling

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

  • Exceptional leadership abilities with a demonstrated commitment to developing and mentoring kitchen staff

  • Creative culinary skills with the ability to design innovative menus whilst respecting traditional cooking methods

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with all levels of staff and management

  • Physical fitness and stamina to handle the demands of a busy kitchen environment

  • Passion for quality ingredients and commitment to delivering consistent, exceptional food

  • Culinary qualification or formal training in professional cooking is preferred


About us

PT Makan Padang Pakai Tangan is a hospitality business dedicated to delivering authentic and memorable culinary experiences to our guests. Restoran Payakumbuah Samarinda represents our commitment to showcasing the rich traditions of Indonesian cuisine in a welcoming and professionally managed environment. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail, quality ingredients, and the skilled craftsmanship of our culinary team. We are seeking individuals who share our passion for exceptional food and outstanding service.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary package commensurate with experience and qualifications

  • Full-time permanent employment with job security

  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organisation

  • A supportive work environment with a collaborative kitchen team

  • Staff meals and dining benefits

  • The chance to be part of a growing hospitality business with a strong reputation for quality


Apply now

If you are an experienced Head Chef with a passion for authentic Indonesian cuisine and strong leadership capabilities, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter detailing your relevant experience, and any references from previous employers. Join our team at Restoran Payakumbuah Samarinda and help us continue to deliver exceptional dining experiences to our guests.

jobs.title: Trip Attendant Bus
jobs.description: Memeriksa daftar penumpang sesuai tiket jangan sampai ada penumpang yang terlewat dari tujuannya. Menyambut penumpang saat masuk ke dalam Bus. Memberikan layanan makanan, minuman dan kebutuhan lainnya selama perjalanan. Membersihkan dan merapikan Bus. Memastikan Bus tetap bersih, teratur dan nyaman untuk penumpang. Memastikan barang bagasi tidak tertukar. Membantu menurunkan barang bagasi penumpang. Memberikan bantuan kepada penumpang yang membutuhkan bantuan khusus. Menanggapi pertanyaan dan kebutuhan penumpang dengan ramah dan profesional. Melaporkan kejadian dan situasi yang perlu dicatat kepada pihak yang berwenang. Melakukan prosedur darurat sesuai dengan pelatihan yang diterima. Terlatih untuk menangani situati darurat seperti kecelakaan atau kondisi medis yang mendesak.

jobs.title: Strategist
jobs.description: At Aleph, we design human-centered digital solutions by combining strategy, technology, and creativity. We work closely with clients, treating their business as our own, to align on goals and drive strategic initiatives through research, data, and insights to solve business challenges. Currently, we are pushing initiatives across the organization to provide strategic advisory on the following topics: User Experience : Strategize App or Web experiences that best fit and build the user mental model, and ensure its desirability (pleasant to use), viability (meet business objectives), and feasibility (can be executed). Customer Experience : Redesign customer experiences and journey maps, leverage customer behavior data and insights to create transformative digital interfaces. Product Development & Management : Transform ideas into market-fit products that meet both user needs and business objectives, while guiding the entire product lifecycle—from concept to optimization. Growth & Experimentation : Use data-driven strategies and experimentation to expand customer base, increase loyalty, and maximize lifetime value. Performance Evaluation & Optimization : Analyze and forecast product KPIs, deliver actionable recommendations to drive growth, improve user engagement, and optimize overall performance. As a Strategist , you will play a pivotal role in pushing new initiatives, with responsibilities including: Collaborating with Designers, Researchers, and Engineers to drive strategic initiatives and guide project direction in partnership with Project Leads. Collaborating with clients to understand their context, challenges, and business goals to sharpen our focus scope. Spearheading the team to conduct in-depth research and data analysis to uncover insights and solutions tailored to client challenges. Experimenting with new approaches and discovering best practices for effective problem-solving. Presenting discovered opportunities and solutions to our clients, engaging audiences from the working team to senior leadership. Your Growth Opportunities As part of this role, you’ll have the chance to: Drive your own initiative, sharpen your leadership skills, and shape the project team direction, with the guidance of senior Strategists for advisory and consultation. Explore opportunities to provide strategic advisory on various topics, including but not limited to: Digital Transformation & Strategy : Redefine the role of digital in client's business and accelerate their transformation efforts. Business Projection & Analysis : Project business outcomes, identify risks, and engage with senior management to discuss strategic pivots and implications. Market Positioning : Identify market opportunities, refine brand positioning to increase visibility and strengthen competitive advantage. Go-to-Market : Craft strategies to launch products and services to the right audience at the right time, from market positioning, messaging, and distribution channel selection. Digital Marketing & Personalization : Optimize digital marketing programs across all channels, utilize analytics and precision targeting to create personalized one-to-one campaigns and journeys. New Ways of Working : Enable organisational changes and help clients transform into digital enterprises that scale effectively. Technology Assessment & Improvements : Assess client’s digital system, technology architecture, SDLC process and methodologies to discover area of improvements for better reliability, security, and scalability

jobs.title: Nail Technician
jobs.description: Lowongan Kerja: Nail Therapist Berpengalaman Lokasi: Jakarta Selatan Kami sedang mencari Nail Therapist berpengalaman yang memiliki keterampilan profesional, ramah kepada pelanggan, dan berkomitmen memberikan pelayanan terbaik untuk bergabung bersama tim kami. Tanggung Jawab Melakukan perawatan kuku tangan dan kaki (manicure & pedicure). Mengaplikasikan gel polish, nail art, nail extension, dan perawatan kuku lainnya sesuai kebutuhan pelanggan. Memberikan konsultasi serta rekomendasi perawatan kuku kepada pelanggan. Menjaga kebersihan alat kerja, area treatment, dan memastikan standar sanitasi selalu terpenuhi. Memastikan kenyamanan serta kepuasan pelanggan selama proses perawatan. Menjaga kualitas hasil kerja sesuai standar salon. Bekerja sama dengan tim untuk menciptakan pelayanan yang profesional. Kualifikasi Wanita, berpenampilan rapi dan profesional. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Nail Therapist. Menguasai manicure, pedicure, gel polish, nail extension, dan nail art. Teliti, cekatan, memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, dan berorientasi pada pelayanan pelanggan. Mampu bekerja dalam tim maupun secara mandiri. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur. Memiliki portofolio hasil pekerjaan menjadi nilai tambah. Benefit Gaji kompetitif. Insentif dan bonus berdasarkan kinerja. Tunjangan sesuai kebijakan perusahaan. Lingkungan kerja yang nyaman dan profesional. Kesempatan mengikuti pelatihan untuk meningkatkan keterampilan. Apabila Anda memiliki pengalaman sebagai Nail Therapist dan ingin berkembang bersama tim kami di Jakarta Selatan, kami mengundang Anda untuk segera melamar.

jobs.company: PT Bintang Emas Sukses Terang (PT. BEST)
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Utama: Mengelola akun media sosial perusahaan (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp Business. Membuat, mengunggah, dan menjadwalkan konten promosi yang menarik untuk produk FMCG dan layanan Fleet Rental Mitra sesuai dengan strategi pemasaran perusahaan. Melakukan promosi digital Berkoordinasi dengan tim penjualan dan operasional dalam menindaklanjuti prospek yang diperoleh dari media sosial. Membuat laporan aktivitas media sosial secara berkala. Memiliki motivasi tinggi, mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan, dan siap mengikuti perkembangan tren digital marketing.

jobs.title: Administrasi HR
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan : Menyusun kontrak kerja/kemitraan, perpanjangan, addendum, serta surat pernyataan terkait. Mengelola dan memperbarui data karyawan dan/atau mitra dalam sistem HR. Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen administrasi, data diri, dan kontrak kerja/kemitraan. Menyiapkan surat-surat kepegawaian (surat keterangan kerja, paklaring, surat referensi, dll). Mengelola pembuatan ID Card karyawan dan/atau mitra. Mengumpulkan dan menyerahkan data administrasi karyawan untuk kebutuhan payroll kepada tim Finance. Melakukan monitoring dan reminder masa berakhir kontrak karyawan dan/atau mitra. Mengelola penyimpanan dan pengarsipan dokumen karyawan/mitra (aktif & tidak aktif) secara tertib. Menjaga kerahasiaan informasi dan dokumen yang terkait dengan karyawan atau mitra. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1 semua jurusan Memiliki pengalaman sebagai administrasi HR minimal 1 tahun Memahami administrasi kontrak kerja dan dokumen kepegawaian Teliti, rapi, dan mampu mengelola data dengan baik Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office, terutama Microsoft Excel (penggunaan rumus dasar hingga menengah) Memiliki komunikasi yang baik dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim

jobs.title: bussiness devlopment
jobs.description: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT PT Bunga Davi Indonesia membuka kesempatan bagi kandidat yang berpengalaman untuk mengembangkan pasar, meningkatkan penjualan, membangun kemitraan strategis, dan menciptakan peluang bisnis baru. Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Mencari dan mengembangkan peluang bisnis baru dari pasar corporate/B2B, partnership, pelanggan institusi, dan florist internasional. Membangun database prospek secara aktif serta melakukan pendekatan, presentasi, negosiasi, follow-up, hingga tercapai kerja sama. Menjalin kerja sama dengan perusahaan, hotel, rumah sakit, properti, perbankan, event organizer, wedding organizer, dan industri potensial lainnya. Membangun hubungan dengan florist internasional yang membutuhkan layanan pemenuhan pesanan bunga di Indonesia. Mengaktifkan kembali partner lama dan menyusun program untuk meningkatkan repeat order. Membuat proposal, presentasi bisnis, quotation, partnership programme, dan penawaran komersial. Melakukan riset pasar, analisis kompetitor, dan analisis kebutuhan pelanggan. Mengelola database, pipeline, dan aktivitas follow-up melalui CRM. Berkoordinasi dengan tim terkait untuk memastikan setiap kerja sama berjalan dengan baik. Mencapai target pelanggan baru, partnership, omzet, conversion, dan repeat order. Kualifikasi: Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Business Development, Partnership, Corporate Sales, atau posisi terkait. Memiliki kemampuan business analysis, business strategy, new business development, dan business negotiation. Terbiasa melakukan prospecting, presentasi, negosiasi, follow-up, dan closing. Mampu berbahasa Inggris secara lisan dan tulisan. Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, dan CRM seperti HubSpot atau Salesforce. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, presentasi, analisis, negosiasi, dan problem-solving yang baik. Berorientasi pada target, pertumbuhan omzet, dan hasil kerja. Bersedia bekerja secara full-time dan WFO di Kebon Jeruk, Jakarta Barat .

jobs.title: Barista
jobs.description: Posisi ini merupakan ujung tombak dalam menyajikan minuman berkualitas dan memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang menyenangkan di Warkop Brmano. Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Menyiapkan dan menyajikan minuman berbasis kopi (espresso-based dan manual brew) serta minuman non-kopi sesuai dengan Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP) Warkop Brmano. Melakukan kalibrasi mesin espresso dan grinder setiap hari untuk memastikan konsistensi rasa kopi. Memberikan pelayanan pelanggan yang ramah, informatif, dan responsif terhadap pesanan atau keluhan. Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian area bar, peralatan seduh, serta mesin kopi. Membantu dalam pencatatan dan pengecekan ketersediaan stok bahan baku (biji kopi, susu, sirup, dll) secara berkala. Mengoperasikan mesin kasir (POS) jika diperlukan dan memastikan transaksi berjalan dengan akurat. Persyaratan (Kualifikasi): Pria/Wanita, usia maksimal 28 tahun. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Barista (lulusan baru/fresh graduate yang memiliki sertifikat pelatihan kopi dipersilakan melamar). Memahami dasar-dasar ekstraksi kopi, kalibrasi mesin, dan latte art dasar. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, ramah, dan berpenampilan menarik/rapi. Jujur, disiplin, dapat bekerja sama dalam tim, dan bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift (termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur nasional).
jobs.raw:
{"@context": "https://schema.org/", "@type": "JobPosting", "title": "Barista", "description": "

Posisi ini merupakan ujung tombak dalam menyajikan minuman berkualitas dan memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang menyenangkan di Warkop Brmano.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

  • Menyiapkan dan menyajikan minuman berbasis kopi (espresso-based dan manual brew) serta minuman non-kopi sesuai dengan Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP) Warkop Brmano.

  • Melakukan kalibrasi mesin espresso dan grinder setiap hari untuk memastikan konsistensi rasa kopi.

  • Memberikan pelayanan pelanggan yang ramah, informatif, dan responsif terhadap pesanan atau keluhan.

  • Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian area bar, peralatan seduh, serta mesin kopi.

  • Membantu dalam pencatatan dan pengecekan ketersediaan stok bahan baku (biji kopi, susu, sirup, dll) secara berkala.

  • Mengoperasikan mesin kasir (POS) jika diperlukan dan memastikan transaksi berjalan dengan akurat.

Persyaratan (Kualifikasi):

  • Pria/Wanita, usia maksimal 28 tahun.

jobs.title: Payroll & Compensation Benefit Assistant Manager
jobs.description: Job Overview We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and proactive Payroll & Compensation Benefit Manager to oversee payroll operations, compensation and benefits administration, employee movement, and HR compliance. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing, competitive compensation practices, effective employee benefits administration, and compliance with Indonesian labor, tax, and social security regulations. Key Responsibilities 1. Payroll Administration Supervise end-to-end monthly payroll processing to ensure accuracy and timely payment. Review payroll components, including attendance, overtime, incentives, allowances, deductions, and employee data changes. Ensure accurate calculation of Income Tax Article 21 (PPh 21) and other payroll-related statutory obligations. Coordinate payroll disbursement with relevant internal stakeholders. Maintain payroll records and ensure confidentiality of employee information. Manage payroll administration and employee data using Talenta HRIS . 2. Compensation Management Assist in developing and evaluating the company's compensation structure and salary scale. Conduct salary and benefits benchmarking against market practices. Perform job evaluation and job grading. Prepare recommendations for salary adjustments, promotions, and remuneration reviews. Ensure consistent implementation of compensation policies across the organization. 3. Benefits Administration Manage employee benefits programs, including BPJS, health insurance, medical claims, and other employee benefits. Administer leave, business travel, and other employee welfare programs. Ensure benefits are provided in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations. Coordinate with external benefit providers and insurance partners. 4. Employee Movement Administration Manage employee movement administration, including promotions, transfers, rotations, demotions, employment status changes, and salary adjustments. Ensure all supporting documentation, approvals, and employee data updates in Talenta HRIS are completed accurately and on time. Coordinate with related stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation of employee movements. Maintain accurate employee master data related to organizational changes. 5. HR Compliance & Reporting Ensure payroll and compensation practices comply with applicable labor laws, tax regulations, social security requirements, and company policies. Monitor regulatory updates related to payroll, taxation, and employment. Prepare payroll, manpower cost, overtime, employee movement, and compensation reports for management. Analyze payroll and compensation data and recommend process improvements. Support internal and external audit activities related to payroll and employee benefits. 6. Team Leadership Supervise and mentor Payroll & Compensation & Benefit team members. Review team outputs to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Support continuous improvement initiatives and team capability development. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Management, Accounting, Finance, Psychology, or a related field. Minimum 4–7 years of experience in Payroll and Compensation & Benefits, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or assistant manager role. Strong knowledge of payroll processing, Compensation & Benefits, Indonesian Labor Law, BPJS, and PPh 21. Hands-on experience using Talenta HRIS , especially for payroll processing, employee database management, attendance, leave administration, and employee movement. Experience handling employee movement administration, job evaluation, salary structure, and compensation review is highly preferred. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with strong analytical abilities. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Detail-oriented, organized, and able to work under tight deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

jobs.title: Head of Sales & Marketing - Packaging Manufacturer
jobs.description: Thir role primarily leading commercial strategy, drive business growth, and strengthen market presence across key customer segments. This role will be responsible for developing and executing sales and marketing initiatives, managing strategic customer relationships, and leading a high-performing commercial team to achieve ambitious growth targets. Client Details Our client is well known local packaging company focusing on flexible packaging Description Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies aligned with business objectives and growth plans. Drive revenue growth, profitability, and market share across existing and new customer segments. Lead, coach, and develop the Sales & Marketing team to build a high-performance culture. Identify new business opportunities and develop strategic plans to expand market presence. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, and business partners. Lead commercial negotiations and ensure successful closure of major business opportunities. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities. Collaborate closely with Production, Supply Chain, R&D, and other internal stakeholders to deliver customer solutions. Manage sales forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking to ensure target achievement. Represent the company at industry events, customer meetings, and strategic business engagements. Profile Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 10 years of sales and marketing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. Strong experience within the packaging industry; candidates from flexible packaging companies are highly preferred. Proven track record in driving sales growth, market expansion, and customer acquisition. Candidates from direct competitors or similar packaging manufacturers will be highly advantageous. Strong leadership, team management, and people development skills. Excellent commercial acumen, negotiation, and strategic planning capabilities. Strong network and relationships within FMCG, food & beverage, consumer goods, or related industries. Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Job Offer Competitive remuneration package, including other benefits career progression Professional growth within a challenging and rewarding role. jobs.title: HRGA Strategist
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Media BersamaSukses mencari HR Strategic Staff yang berpengalaman dan strategis untuk bergabung dengan tim Sumber Daya Manusia kami di Surabaya, Jawa Timur. Sebagai HR Strategic Staff, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan strategi sumber daya manusia yang mendukung pertumbuhan dan kesuksesan organisasi. Kandidat yang ideal memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang manajemen talenta, perencanaan karir, dan budaya perusahaan, serta mampu menerjemahkan visi HR menjadi inisiatif yang terukur dan berdampak. Posisi ini ditawarkan sebagai pekerjaan fulltime yang berbasis di Surabaya, Jawa Timur. Deskripsi Pekerjaan (Jobdesk) Bertanggung jawab atas proses end-to-end recruitment , mulai dari pencarian kandidat hingga onboarding. Menyusun strategi penempatan, pengembangan, dan pengelolaan talenta sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan. Mengelola administrasi HR, termasuk data karyawan, absensi, serta administrasi BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. Melakukan monitoring dan evaluasi implementasi KPI, SOP, serta pengembangan budaya kerja. Mengelola kebutuhan General Affairs (GA), termasuk fasilitas kantor, aset, dan koordinasi operasional pendukung.Menjadi business partner bagi manajemen dalam pengambilan keputusan terkait SDM Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Psikologi, Manajemen SDM, atau bidang terkait Pengalaman minimal 2–4 tahun di bidang HR, diutamakan pada HR Strategy / Organization/ People Development Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai HR framework (KPI, performance management, competency, dll) Terbiasa bekerja dengan data dan memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan stakeholder management yang baik Proaktif, strategic thinking, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun tim Menguasai Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (diutamakan mampu mengolah data) Memahami regulasi ketenagakerjaan di Indonesia menjadi nilai tambah Tentang Kami PT Media BersamaSukses adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi media dan bisnis berkualitas tinggi di Indonesia. Dengan fokus pada inovasi, keunggulan operasional, dan pengembangan talenta, kami telah membangun reputasi sebagai mitra terpercaya bagi klien di berbagai industri. Kami menjunjung tinggi nilai-nilai integritas, kolaborasi, dan pertumbuhan berkelanjutan. Perusahaan kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang dinamis di mana setiap anggota tim didorong untuk berkontribusi ide terbaik mereka dan mengembangkan potensi penuh mereka. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami bergantung pada talenta terbaik dan komitmen kami terhadap pengembangan karyawan jangka panjang.

About the role

PT Satyaraya Keramindoindah is seeking a dedicated HSE & K3 (Health, Safety, Environment & Occupational Safety) Specialist to join our team in Tangerang, Banten. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in safeguarding our workforce and ensuring compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations across all construction operations. The HSE & K3 Specialist will be instrumental in developing, implementing, and monitoring safety programmes that protect our employees, contractors, and stakeholders whilst maintaining our commitment to environmental responsibility and operational excellence.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, and guidelines aligned with Indonesian regulations and international best practices

  • Conduct regular risk assessments and hazard analyses across all construction sites and operational areas to identify potential dangers and recommend control measures

  • Plan, organise, and deliver safety training programmes to all staff levels, including induction training, toolbox talks, and specialist safety courses

  • Perform routine site inspections and safety audits to ensure compliance with HSE standards, regulations, and company policies

  • Investigate incidents, accidents, and near-misses to determine root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

  • Maintain detailed HSE documentation, records, and reports including incident logs, training registers, and compliance documentation

  • Collaborate with project managers, supervisors, and site teams to establish safe working conditions and promote a strong safety culture

  • Liaise with regulatory authorities and external agencies to ensure all legal requirements are met and maintain necessary certifications

  • Develop and manage emergency response procedures and conduct regular drills to prepare teams for potential incidents

  • Monitor and report on key HSE performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to senior management


What we're looking for

  • Minimum 3-5 years of proven experience in HSE and K3 roles within the Manufacture/Construction industry or related sectors

  • Formal qualification in Occupational Health and Safety (such as Bachelor Degree in Technic or related field)

  • Valid K3 certification or equivalent professional qualification recognised in Indonesia (Plus Point)

  • Thorough knowledge of Indonesian health and safety legislation, including Law No. 1 of 1970 concerning Occupational Safety and relevant regulations

  • Strong understanding of construction site hazards, risk management methodologies, and accident prevention techniques

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with all levels of staff

  • Proficiency in English and Indonesian language (both written and verbal)

  • Competency in using MS Office applications and HSE management software

  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities

  • Current first aid certification or willingness to obtain one

  • Preferred: Experience with ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems) or similar management systems


What we offer

PT Satyaraya Keramindoindah is committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where safety and employee wellbeing are paramount. We offer competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience and qualifications. Our benefits include comprehensive health insurance coverage, professional development opportunities, and ongoing training to enhance your HSE expertise. We provide a collaborative work environment where your contributions are valued and recognised. The company fosters a culture of continuous improvement and invests in the latest safety technologies and resources. We also offer opportunities for career progression within our growing organisation, and flexible working arrangements where feasible. Your wellbeing is important to us, and we encourage an open dialogue regarding any support or adjustments you may require.

About us

PT Satyaraya Keramindoindah is a respected construction company operating in Indonesia with a strong commitment to delivering quality projects whilst maintaining the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental responsibility. With a dedicated workforce and proven track record in the construction sector, we are known for our professionalism, reliability, and adherence to stringent safety protocols. Our mission is to build not only structures but also a legacy of safety excellence and environmental stewardship. We believe that every project should be completed without compromising the wellbeing of our people or the environment. The company values integrity, teamwork, and continuous improvement, fostering a workplace culture where safety is everyone's responsibility and success is celebrated collectively.

Apply now

If you are a qualified HSE & K3 professional with a passion for promoting workplace safety and environmental protection, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, relevant certifications, and a cover letter outlining your experience and interest in this position. Join PT Satyaraya Keramindoindah and make a meaningful impact on construction safety in Indonesia.

jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Utama : Merancang sistem mekanik, listrik, dan plambing sesuai dengan spesifikasi teknis, regulasi bangunan, dan standar keselamatan yang berlaku. Mengelola perencanaan dan scheduling instalasi sistem mekanik, listrik, dan plambing sesuai timeline proyek. Berkolaborasi untuk memastikan eksekusi proyek yang efisien dan profesional. Mengelola dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis, blueprint, dan laporan-laporan proyek MEP. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal Diploma atau Sarjana (S1) dalam bidang Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, atau Teknik Sistem Plambing Pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang Mechanical Electrical Plumbing atau posisi teknis terkait dalam industri konstruksi atau infrastruktur. Keahlian dalam membaca dan menginterpretasi blueprint, gambar teknis, dan spesifikasi engineering. Keterampilan kepemimpinan tim dan manajemen proyek yang kuat. Pengalaman dalam koordinasi proyek berskala besar atau proyek komersial/industrial dianggap sebagai nilai tambah.

Pada posisi ini nantinya bertanggung jawab pada target SPK dan DO setiap bulanya. Tanggungjawab : Melayani dan mengonversi pelanggan walk-in di showroom serta mengelola prospek (leads) yang masuk melalui situs iklan perusahaan secara responsif. Melakukan aktivitas prospecting dan pendekatan strategis untuk memperluas jaringan konsumen potensial. Mampu mencapai dan melampaui target penjualan unit kendaraan harian, mingguan, maupun bulanan yang ditetapkan perusahaan. Mendampingi pelanggan secara profesional selama seluruh proses pembelian, termasuk membantu koordinasi dengan pihak pembiayaan ( leasing ) kendaraan. Menjaga hubungan baik jangka panjang melalui layanan follow-up pasca-transaksi ( after-sales service ) untuk membangun loyalitas konsumen. Mempresentasikan unit kendaraan secara komprehensif, menjelaskan spesifikasi produk kendaraan dan produk pendamping dari perusahaan ( warranty ) Memandu pelanggan dalam sesi uji coba kendaraan ( test drive ). Kualifikasi : Minimal Lulusan SMA (semua jurusan) Teliti, rapi, dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline. Pengalaman di industri otomotif menjadi nilai tambah Memiliki pengetahuan dasar mengenai spesifikasi dan harga mobil Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang sales Menguasai atau mengetahui marketplace otomotif Mampu membangun dan memelihara hubungan dengan klien Bersedia penempatan area Jakarta Utara / Tangerang Benefit: Gaji Pokok Insentif unit (Cash/Credit)

If you are a motivated technical professional with strong management capabilities and a passion for operational excellence, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, and any additional certifications or qualifications to our recruitment team. Join PT Pan Brothers, Tbk and contribute to our mission of delivering world-class textile and apparel manufacturing solutions.

jobs.title: Operations & Accounting Administrator (Retail / Jewelry Manufacturing)
jobs.description: MANOJA is a conscious fine jewelry brand dedicated to slow fashion, ethical craftsmanship, and mindful luxury. We create timeless pieces using recycled precious metals, conflict-free gemstones, and biodegradable packaging. As we expand our retail presence and international distribution, we are looking for a detail-oriented, trustworthy, and proactive Operations & Accounting Administrator to join our team and help keep our day-to-day business running seamlessly. Job Description: In this dual role, you will be the administrative backbone of both our financial tracking and daily operations. Working closely with the founder, you will manage local inventory, process vendor payments, prepare crucial shipping and export paperwork, and maintain flawless bookkeeping. The ideal candidate thrives on organization, possesses high attention to detail, understands small business accounting, and has prior experience in the retail, fashion, or manufacturing sector. Key Responsibilities: Accounting & Financial Admin: Invoicing & Billing: Generate and manage accurate customer invoices, receipts, and payment records. Bookkeeping: Handle day-to-day bookkeeping, including accounts payable (paying local artisans, suppliers, and vendors) and accounts receivable. Reconciliation: Reconcile monthly bank statements, credit card transactions, and digital payment gateways on time. Cost & Overhead Tracking: Track production costs, raw material expenses (precious metals, gemstones), and operational overhead. Tax Preparation: Organize and prepare necessary documentation for local tax purposes (VAT/PPN, income data) and coordinate closely with our external tax consultant. Operations, Logistics & Admin Support: Shipping & Export Paperwork: Prepare, review, and organize all required shipping paperwork—including detailed commercial invoices, customs declarations, and packing lists for local and international orders for tax and export compliance. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate with international and local courier services, manage shipping documentation, and ensure smooth customs clearance for outbound orders and inbound materials. Inventory Management: Oversee regular inventory tracking and stock counts for raw materials, packaging supplies, and finished jewelry pieces. General Administration: Handle daily office administrative tasks, digital filing, vendor communications, and remote alignment with the founder. Requirements: Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of hands-on experience in bookkeeping, accounting, or administrative roles. Direct experience in the retail, fashion, or manufacturing industry is strongly preferred. Education: Bachelor’s degree or Diploma (D3/S1) in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Language Skills: Strong written and spoken communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English (essential for international logistics and aligning with remote leadership). Technical Skills: Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., Xero, QuickBooks, Jurnal, or Accurate) and MS Excel. Solid understanding of international shipping paperwork (commercial invoices, packing lists) and tax/VAT preparation. Key Attributes: High integrity, strong organization, self-motivated, and capable of working independently to meet monthly financial and operational deadlines. A genuine appreciation for sustainable fashion and design is a plus. What We Offer: A creative, respectful, and values-driven workplace culture. A key role with opportunities for professional growth as the brand expands globally. Competitive compensation package reflecting experience. Flexible working arrangements. How to Apply: If you are an organized, numbers-driven professional who wants to grow with an ethical brand, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your updated CV, expected salary, and a brief cover letter via JobStreet explaining why your background in retail, fashion, or accounting makes you a great fit for MANOJA.

jobs.title: Chemistry Teacher for Highfield School Bogor (Secondary Level)
jobs.description: Company Overview: Kinderfield Highfield School Bogor is a leading educational institution committed to providing a nurturing and holistic learning environment for students from preschool up to secondary levels. Our mission is to empower students with knowledge, skills, and values that will prepare them for a successful future. We shape our students to thrive in the globalized world of the 21st century as a Responsible-to-Life generation. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced School Principal to lead our dedicated team of educators and support staff in achieving our educational goals. Position Overview: We are looking for an experienced and passionate Secondary Chemistry Teacher to teach the Cambridge curriculum for 2026/2027 academic school year. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Chemistry education, a deep understanding of the Cambridge curriculum (IGCSE & A -Level), and a genuine desire to inspire students to excel in their studies. Key Responsibilities: Teach the Cambridge curriculum to secondary school students, fostering a love for Chemistry. Develop and deliver engaging and effective lesson plans that cater to diverse learning needs. Create a positive and inclusive classroom environment that encourages active participation and critical thinking. Assess student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents. Collaborate with colleagues to enhance curriculum delivery and student learning outcomes. Participate in professional development activities to stay updated with best practices in Chemistry Qualifications: Willing to be placed in Bogor, Jawa Barat Available to join in the middle of the 2026-2027 Academic Year Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or related field (Master's degree is a plus). Teaching certification or relevant teaching qualifications. Minimum of 2 years of experience teaching Chemistry in a secondary school setting. Familiarity with the Cambridge curriculum is highly desirable. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. A passion for teaching and a commitment to student success. Enthusiasm for professional growth and development. What We Offer: Competitive salary Supportive and collaborative work environment. Opportunities for professional development and growth. A chance to make a positive impact on students' lives. How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to submit the following documents: - A cover letter detailing your qualifications and teaching philosophy. - A current resume/CV. - Copies of relevant degrees, certifications, and teaching licenses. - Contact information for at least three professional references. - Please ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of this position. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Kinderfield Highfield School Bogor is a leading educational institution committed to providing a nurturing and holistic learning environment for students from preschool up to secondary levels. Our mission is to empower students with knowledge, skills, and values that will prepare them for a successful future. We shape our students to thrive in the globalized world of the 21st century as a Responsible-to-Life generation. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced School Principal to lead our dedicated team of educators and support staff in achieving our educational goals.


Position Overview:

We are looking for an experienced and passionate Secondary Chemistry Teacher to teach the Cambridge curriculum for 2026/2027 academic school year. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Chemistry education, a deep understanding of the Cambridge curriculum (IGCSE & A -Level), and a genuine desire to inspire students to excel in their studies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Teach the Cambridge curriculum to secondary school students, fostering a love for Chemistry.

  • Develop and deliver engaging and effective lesson plans that cater to diverse learning needs.

  • Create a positive and inclusive classroom environment that encourages active participation and critical thinking.

  • Assess student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

  • Collaborate with colleagues to enhance curriculum delivery and student learning outcomes.

  • Participate in professional development activities to stay updated with best practices in Chemistry

  • Willing to be placed in Bogor, Jawa Barat

  • Available to join in the middle of the 2026-2027 Academic Year

  • Teaching certification or relevant teaching qualifications.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience teaching Chemistry in a secondary school setting.

  • Familiarity with the Cambridge curriculum is highly desirable.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A passion for teaching and a commitment to student success.

  • Enthusiasm for professional growth and development.

  • Competitive salary

- Copies of relevant degrees, certifications, and teaching licenses.

- Contact information for at least three professional references.

- Please ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of this position. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.title: SPV Inventory Control
jobs.description: Mengawasi dan memastikan akurasi data persediaan barang di gudang dan seluruh outlet. Merencanakan, mengoordinasikan, dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan stock opname secara berkala. Menganalisis selisih stok serta melakukan investigasi dan tindak lanjut atas temuan. Memastikan seluruh proses keluar masuk barang sesuai dengan SOP yang berlaku. Melakukan monitoring terhadap pergerakan stok, stok mati (dead stock), dan potensi kehilangan barang. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Gudang, Purchasing, dan Operasional Outlet untuk menjaga ketersediaan dan keakuratan stok. Membuat laporan hasil audit, stock opname, serta rekomendasi perbaikan kepada manajemen. Membina, mengarahkan, dan mengevaluasi kinerja tim Inventory Control. Memastikan seluruh aktivitas Inventory Control berjalan efektif, efisien, dan sesuai dengan standar perusahaan.
